notes: Original Sieverts H2 uptake on activated carbon hollow fibers (steam-activated, wood-derived) at 77 K, 1 bar and 100 bar (Fig. 4a, 4b). Not a review, not retracted (record.json is_retracted false; no retraction notice in text), no statement that the H2 values were published earlier. The Conclusions state 4.51 wt% at 298 K and 100 bar, which conflicts with the abstract, Results and Fig. 4 (77 K); T and P are still stated, so I3 is met, but the temperature should be checked at extraction. The surface-area method is named only in the Fig. 3 inset (BET surface area); the text calls it specific surface area and N2 isotherms at 77 K were measured (Methods).
